crossRefs.note: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to…
having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in…
and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.
by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,
in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I married you to one husband, that I might present you as a pure…
even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in…
that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it…
For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.
who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify for himself a people for his own…
Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and…
Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in…
Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;
Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through…

translations.web: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
translations.bsb: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence—
translations.kjv: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
translations.asv: yet now hath he reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without blemish and unreproveable before him:
